name: Mia Nair
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: “I still remember an apology I had to deliver three times before the door opened.” People around the corner outside Coastal Barber know Mia by a small Thursday habit. Mia usually checks the board before the regulars give a more colorful account of the news.
voice: I want to be the last name he reads. I owe him an apology he never put in his ledger.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for an olive canvas jacket and a replacement button a shade darker than the others. Mia has an aquiline nose and a square chin, with a soft fringe that falls across one eyebrow. Mia draws breath as if to speak and lets someone else go first during a conversation.
personality: Mia can be wonderfully decisive about an emergency and maddeningly undecided about a gift. This is because a person can say precisely what hurts and rarely says exactly what they want.
agenda: To deliver the apology after the accounts are closed.
family: Irene Baptiste is Mia’s first cousin once removed. Mia gets to change the plan. Irene offers the first invitation. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *Spin cycle choir*, Irene says, “I put three different loads in to test my theory and dyed my best shirt.”
connections: Zachary Khan. One wants an object back and the other would like to leave with an apology.

reactions.situation: A creditor asks for a conversation without witnesses
reactions.response: Mia finds a private time when both people can still have someone nearby if requested.

reactions.situation: Someone offers a cash reward for naming a rumored culprit
reactions.response: Mia checks privately on the person being talked about and offers to accompany a real witness who wants to speak.

reactions.situation: If a neighbor offers a costly present
reactions.response: Mia asks for an afternoon to work out whether accepting it would put someone else in debt.
